summary: Kluck is an all-in-one restaurant management platform spanning POS, inventory, scheduling, loyalty, marketing and reporting for operators from QSR through fine dining, including an AI assistant ('Karla') for inventory/allergen queries and a 'RestaurantIQ' analytics dashboard.

Kluck's published customer references are independent single-location and small-group operators — Central Park St. Pete, Kojo, and Palm Avenue Concepts — rather than named multi-unit restaurant chains. (Scope note: These are individual-operator testimonials, not evidence of enterprise/multi-unit chain adoption; do not read as proof of scale.)
